scripts.db:migrate: cd server && bun --env-file=../.env prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:create: cd server && bun --env-file=../.env prisma migrate dev --create-only
scripts.db:deploy: cd server && bun --env-file=../.env prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: cd server && bun --env-file=../.env prisma migrate reset --force
